Priya Patel: Quick async spot-check for Q2 milestones — please post a one-line status: shipped / slipped / partial + any CR pings or blockers. Keep it short, owners only.

Alex Chen: Data-plane v1 -> shipped to canary yesterday. Perf looks stable so far (95th -12%). Need a cleanup CR: @Maya Ortiz @Jon Rivera please review https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/482

Maya Ortiz: On it, will review today. Saw one retry-backoff oddity in the logs, might add a small fix. :mag:

Jon Rivera: Routing-policy v2 -> slipped. Integration tests fail for batch sizes >32, reproing looks like KV cache blowup under heavy concurrency. Investigating, ETA EOD. Assigning @Sam B to help with repro.

Sam B: Happy to help. I can repro locally with this script — ```bash ./repro.sh --batch 64 --concurrency 8``` — will open a draft PR if I find a quick mitigation (probably backpressure tweak). Also pinging @Tara Nguyen about autoscale settings.

Tara Nguyen: Increased staging min_replicas from 2 -> 3 for the affected pool, watching metrics. If stable in 2 runs, I'll promote to canary tomorrow morning.

Priya Patel: Thanks — owners recap: Alex = data-plane, Jon = routing, Sam = fix, Tara = autoscale. Please add your final shipped/slipped status to the OKR doc and drop CR links there: https://docs.redwood.com/okrs/q2-milestones

CI-bot: Build passed for PR #482 (commit 4f2b7c). Canary deploy triggered at 2024-06-10T14:12Z :rocket:

Alex Chen: Added CR comments and tagged reviewers. Marked milestone as "partial shipped" in the doc (canary only).

Maya Ortiz: Reviewed PR #482, left one small nit about log formatting. @Alex if you can address, I can LGTM and we can promote.

Jon Rivera: Filed ticket #890 for the regression test gap and started a branch with expanded integration tests. Will link PR once I have a passing run.

Priya Patel: Solid progress — reconvene next Tue for a short sync if anything still open. If you need a quick live 15m, react with :phone:.
